Name: Lumisteria Flowers and Crops
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: This packs adds 17 flowers and 2 crops, in various seasons, including some winter flowers, and the ability to discover seeds or flowers in the wild.
Description:
**For 1.6 Users :Consider using : **[Lumisteria Serene Meadow](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20598)****
The Successor of this mod :)**What's in the mod ?**

17 flowers and 2 crops, growing in various seasons, including some winter flowers, and the ability to discover seeds or flowers in the wild.

Gift tastes for each flower and crop. Most villagers have at least one loved gift !

Crops being sold at different shops and different years, up to year 4 for some of them.

And if you don't like waiting, dig artifact spots to see if you can discover some seeds. They aren't common but they can be found on some days and place...

Some of the plants have giant version, like vanilla crops... You'll need a bit of luck to see them.

**1.0.5** : now include german translation by [Jely](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2796938).

----

**1.0.4** : now includes turkish translation by [KeDili](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/108727003).

----**1.0.3** : now includes Chinese translation by vNIANHUAv.
Also includes some new tags for some flowers (pansy, calendula, tall mallow, borage) to allow them to be made in jelly in my [pickled produce](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7784) mod.

----
**1.0.2** : now includes Korean translation by [Kaya](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/48693548?).
----
**1.0.1** : now includes Russian translation by "6squad". If you already downloaded it and aren't interested by russian translation you can ignore the update for now :)

----

This mod requires Json Assets (for the actual items) and Farm Type Manager (to obtain some of the items in alternate ways).

-----
You are a modder that want to sell crops or items of this mod, or wants to spawn some of the forage in your custom location ? Please contact me here or on the stardew discord ! :)

-----
Note that these crops may be inspired by real flowers and plants but not always share the same properties (growing time, edibility) than their real counterparts.
